caption: The third interval is twice the normal length and crosses the pause threshold; the shaded region marks intervals above 1500 ms. This is what one missed beat looks like.

spec.aria: Three RR intervals are 800 ms, 800 ms and 1600 ms; the third is longer than the 1500 ms pause threshold, so the monitor alarms. A shaded region above 1500 ms marks the threshold.
